review_candidates.description: Company Description Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty. But where does that take you? Job Description We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) (unlimited, full-time) to join our Business Infrastructure Platform (BIP) team located in Tallinn. The BIP team is the backbone of the organization’s infrastructure - designing, building, and maintaining the platform with 40+ teams onboard. From cloud engineering and automation to monitoring, security, and performance optimization, we make sure the foundation is rock-solid so others can build amazing things on top of it. If you’re passionate about modern cloud technologies, platform reliability, and engineering excellence, you’ll feel right at home with us. What will be your challenge? Shape the future of our cloud infrastructure by designing, developing, and testing secure, scalable solutions tailored to real business needs. Play a key role in deploying and maintaining services such as Kubernetes, HashiCorp Vault & Consul, and databases including Azure SQL Server, MongoDB Atlas, and RabbitMQ. Keep us proactive by creating and fine-tuning monitoring and alerting systems with Azure Monitor and New Relic. Document for clarity and scale – documentation not just for the team, but also for our internal clients, with a goal to make life easier for everyone. Take full responsibility for your work, from architecture up until implementation and monitoring - share and present your design decisions to the team, drive alignment and innovation. Collaborate and elevate - work closely with teams using the BIP platform to improve their infrastructure implementations and set them up for success. Qualifications What do you need to succeed in this role? Hands-on experience working with an infrastructure as code approach using Terraform. Hands-on experience working with Azure cloud and Kubernetes. Experience one of the scripting languages, PowerShell, bash, or Python. Experience setting up and working with security, monitoring & alerting solutions (Azure Monitor, New Relic, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, etc.) Familiarity with CI/CD approach for application and infrastructure deployment. Familiarity with containerization using Docker. Additional Information Our Plus Points Inclusive and valuing culture: At Riverty, you can be who you are. Monetary Benefits & Discounts: Know that you're appreciated with plenty of employee benefits & discounts just for you. Flexibility: Our diverse working models empower you to customize your work to perfectly align with your preferences. Benefit from mobile office, flexible working hours and part-time models. More information on riverty.com/careers. Are you already convinced? Then we look forward to receiving your online application – with just a few clicks.
